summary.summary_narrative: SentraIPS completed assessment for capture 'report_34328_demo_capture'. Evaluated risk score is 15/100 (LOW). Observed cryptographic parameters: IKEv2, AES-256-GCM, DH ecp256 (19), PFS Unknown / Not Detected. Encrypted traffic classified as 'Web' with 100.0% confidence.

score_breakdown.title: Traffic Analysis & Flow Pattern Exposure
score_breakdown.reason: Even with strong encryption, packet size distributions, burst dynamics, and inter-arrival timing remain visible to network eavesdroppers, allowing application profiling (e.g. identifying VoIP vs Web vs Video).

score_breakdown.title: Cleartext IKE Handshake Metadata
score_breakdown.reason: The initial IKE_SA_INIT exchange exposes initiator and responder Security Parameter Indexes (SPIs) and cryptographic negotiation proposals in cleartext.

findings.title: Traffic Analysis & Flow Pattern Exposure
findings.description: Even with strong encryption, packet size distributions, burst dynamics, and inter-arrival timing remain visible to network eavesdroppers, allowing application profiling (e.g. identifying VoIP vs Web vs Video).

evidence.packet_source: Outer IP/ESP packet headers and inter-arrival timestamps

findings.impact: Passive observers can profile application traffic types (VoIP, video, file transfers) from timing and packet sizes.
findings.recommendation: Consider implementing IPsec traffic flow confidentiality (TFC) padding (RFC 4303) to mask packet sizes and timing characteristics.

findings.title: Cleartext IKE Handshake Metadata
findings.description: The initial IKE_SA_INIT exchange exposes initiator and responder Security Parameter Indexes (SPIs) and cryptographic negotiation proposals in cleartext.
findings.impact: External network observers learn gateway identity and supported cryptographic suites from initial negotiation.
findings.recommendation: This is an unavoidable architectural aspect of IKEv2 negotiation. Ensure gateway external IP addresses are protected behind border firewalls.

recommendations.title: Verify Unobserved Parameters (pfs)
recommendations.action: Capture initial IKE_SA_INIT UDP 500/4500 exchange packets at tunnel setup, or verify IPSec configuration directly on the security gateway / strongSwan configuration.
recommendations.rationale: The following security parameters could not be observed from the packet capture: pfs. This typically occurs when the capture began after IKE SA negotiation, or when Child SA proposals are negotiated inside encrypted IKE_AUTH payloads.

limitations: ESP payload contents are fully encrypted; analysis is strictly limited to observable outer packet headers, SPI metadata, and sequence progression.
Rekeyed Child SA transform attributes negotiated inside encrypted IKE_AUTH or CREATE_CHILD_SA payloads cannot be observed without decryption keys.
PFS status was not observable from capture alone.
Encrypted ESP payload contents were never decrypted; all analysis is derived strictly from outer packet headers and inter-arrival timing.
ML traffic classification represents a probabilistic inference based on observed outer packet size and burst distributions, not deterministic payload inspection.
